newsitem.title: UK: C&W Communications beefs up management team.
newsitem.headline: C&W Communications beefs up management team.

text.p: Cable and Wireless Communications, the proposed merger between the British units of four cable companies, on Tuesday announced seven further appointments to its senior management team.
Five directors come from Mercury Communications, the UK unit of Cable and Wireless with the remaining two from the other partners -- Bell Cablemedia/Videotron and NYNEX CableComms.

Darren Entwistle, strategy director of Mercury Communications, will be business development director, Mercury's home business services and business enterprise services director Adrian Chamberlain will be managing director, consumer markets.
C&W Communications' managing director, SME markets will be Mercury's Ian Hinchliffe, currently managing director, general business services at Mercury.

Managing director, corporate markets goes to Rob Fisher, managing director, international business services at Mercury and Mercury's David Wickham takes on the post of managing director, International & Partner Services.

The merged Bell Cablemedia/Videotron division is providing C&W Communcations' managing director, customer operations, in the form of Gilles Leclerc, currently managing director, residential markets at the U.S. firm.
Ted Hatch, currently executive director, network development, residential marketing and programming at NYNEX CableComms becomes managing director, networks at C&W Communications.
C&W Communications will be Britain's biggest cable company if the merger is completed as planned in spring.

"These appointments are another significant step forward and will, I believe, ensure that Cable & Wireless Communications gets off to the best possible start," said Graham Wallace, C&W Communications' chief executive.
